grain_rationale: The profile reports row_count 166158 and duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so every source row is a distinct scheduled flight leg departing one of the three New York origin airports and each row is an event in its own right, which makes grain_type transaction appropriate. No single column is unique on its own (the largest distinct_count among candidate keys is tail_number at 3825 and flight_number at 2994, both far below row_count), so identity is declared as a derived tuple over flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport and sched_dep_hhmm, the combination that pins one leg on one operating day at one scheduled departure clock time. Because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 there are no exact duplicate rows for the identity tuple to absorb and no need to aggregate; if duplicates were to appear in a later load the identity tuple would collapse them to a single line rather than silently double-count delay or distance measures.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: Operating day of the scheduled flight leg, spanning min 2013-01-01 to max 2013-06-30 across 181 distinct days with null_rate 0.0, carried as a dimension because the event is timestamped by departure_hour_utc.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: Two-letter operating carrier code with only 16 distinct values such as 9E, DL, UA and WN and null_rate 0.0, a classic low-cardinality label dimension.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Carrier-assigned flight number ranging 1 to 8500 over 2994 distinct values with null_rate 0.0; it is an identifier stored as a number and so is mapped as a dimension rather than a measure.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: Origin airport code restricted to the three New York area fields EWR, JFK and LGA with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled local departure clock time encoded as HHMM between 500 and 2359 with null_rate 0.0; the digits label a time of day rather than quantify anything, so it is a dimension.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: Destination airport code with 100 distinct values sampled as ABQ, ATL, BNA and similar and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Registration mark of the operating aircraft over 3825 distinct values such as N104UW; nullable at null_rate 0.009154, consistent with legs whose aircraft assignment was never recorded, typically cancellations.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: Flag with distinct values false and true and null_rate 0.0 marking whether the scheduled leg was cancelled; a flag is always a dimension.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: Actual local departure clock time encoded as HHMM from 1 to 2400; nullable at null_rate 0.029388 because legs that never departed have no actual departure time, and the HHMM encoding labels rather than measures.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Departure delay in minutes ranging -33 (early) to 1301, an additive and comparable quantity and therefore a measure; nullable at null_rate 0.029388 for legs with no actual departure.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: Actual local arrival clock time encoded as HHMM from 1 to 2400, a clock label rather than a quantity; nullable at null_rate 0.0307 where the leg did not arrive.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled local arrival clock time encoded as HHMM between 1 and 2359 with null_rate 0.0, a clock label and so a dimension.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Arrival delay in minutes ranging -86 to 1272, averaged and summed across legs and therefore a measure; nullable at null_rate 0.032981 for cancelled or diverted legs.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Elapsed airborne time in minutes from 20 to 695, an additive quantity and therefore a measure; nullable at null_rate 0.032981 where the leg never flew.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Great-circle distance of the route in miles from 80 to 4983 with null_rate 0.0, summed to produce flown mileage and so a measure.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: Local scheduled departure hour with 19 distinct values from 5 to 23 and null_rate 0.0, a time-of-day bucket label and so a dimension.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: Local scheduled departure minute with 60 distinct values from 0 to 59 and null_rate 0.0, a clock component label and so a dimension.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp of the scheduled departure hour spanning 2013-01-01T10:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00 with null_rate 0.0; samples land exactly on hour boundaries, so it timestamps each leg at hour resolution.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Human-readable carrier name with the same 16 distinct values as carrier_code, such as Delta Air Lines Inc. and JetBlue Airways, and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: Airframe manufacturer of the tail number over 34 distinct values such as BOEING, AIRBUS and EMBRAER; nullable at null_rate 0.160426 where the tail number has no registry match.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: Aircraft model designation over 121 distinct values such as 172N and 550; nullable at null_rate 0.160426, the same registry-miss rate as aircraft_manufacturer.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: Year the airframe was built, from 1956 to 2013; a year labels the aircraft rather than quantifying the flight, so it is a dimension, and it is nullable at null_rate 0.176531.

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: Registered seat capacity of the airframe from 2 to 450, a count that is summed to estimate offered capacity across legs and so a measure; nullable at null_rate 0.160426 where the registry lookup failed.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: Engine category with six distinct values including Turbo-fan, Turbo-jet and Turbo-prop; nullable at null_rate 0.160426 for unmatched tail numbers.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: Full name of the origin airport, one of three values such as LaGuardia Airport, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: City of the origin airport, either New York or Newark, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: Field elevation of the origin airport with only three distinct values 13, 18 and 21 and null_rate 0.0; it describes the airport rather than the flight, so it is a dimension.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway length at the origin airport with three distinct values 7002, 11000 and 14511 and null_rate 0.0, an airport attribute and so a dimension.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: Full name of the destination airport over 99 distinct values such as Boston Logan International Airport; nullable at null_rate 0.02089 where the destination code has no reference match.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: City of the destination airport over 95 distinct values such as Atlanta and Albuquerque; nullable at null_rate 0.02089, the same reference-miss rate as dest_airport_name.

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: ISO region of the destination over 45 distinct values such as US-CA and PR-U-A; nullable at null_rate 0.02089 for unmatched destination codes.

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: Field elevation of the destination airport from 3 to 6606 feet, an airport attribute and so a dimension; nullable at null_rate 0.02089.

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway length at the destination airport from 5076 to 16000 feet, an airport attribute and so a dimension; nullable at null_rate 0.02089.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Load capture timestamp with 16 distinct values clustered between 2026-09-02T23:25:51 and 2026-09-02T23:26:06 and null_rate 0.0; it stamps the ingestion batch, not the flight, so it is carried as a dimension and never as the event time.

category_description: One row is one scheduled flight leg departing a New York area airport (EWR, JFK or LGA) on a given operating day, identified by the combination of flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport and sched_dep_hhmm, and timestamped at its UTC scheduled departure hour. Each row carries the leg's route and carrier labels, aircraft registry attributes joined from the tail number, origin and destination airport reference attributes, and the leg's departure delay, arrival delay, air time, distance and offered seat capacity.
purpose: This mapping declares how silver.silver_flights enters the gold unified event star as the flight_departures fact category: which column timestamps the event and at what grain, which columns identify a single leg, and which of the 34 mapped columns act as dimensions, measures or the time anchor. Its consumer is the deterministic modeling engine, which reads the approved contract and emits the gold models; no table, view or transformation is proposed here.
usage: The proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, linted and checked by the validator, then reviewed and edited by a human before approval. Once approved, the modeling engine builds the flight_departures fact from silver.silver_flights, deriving flight_leg_identity by canonical-key-v2 over the declared tuple and conforming the dimension columns into the shared star; analysts query the resulting gold models rather than this contract.
limitations: The mapping declares grain and roles only: it applies no filters, no renaming and no derivation beyond the declared identity, so cancelled legs (is_cancelled true) remain in the fact and consumers must exclude them when computing on-time or air-time statistics, since dep_hhmm, dep_delay_minutes, arr_delay_minutes and air_time_minutes are nullable at rates of 0.029388 to 0.032981 largely for those legs. Aircraft registry attributes are missing for roughly one row in six (null_rate 0.160426, and 0.176531 for manufacture year) and destination reference attributes for 0.02089 of rows, so fleet and destination breakdowns are incomplete by construction. The HHMM clock columns are encoded integers and are mapped as dimensions, so they must not be arithmetically differenced as if they were minute counts, and captured_at reflects ingestion timing only. The contract carries no quality rules, severities, classifications, service levels, ownership or access policy; those belong to review.
